role: INDEPENDENT ADVERSARIAL REVIEW of artifacts/plan-and-policy-identity-recipes.v3.json. This review binds nothing, closes nothing, and changes no status, disposition, verdict or seal.
verdict: REJECT FOR REPAIR -- DO NOT APPLY AS WRITTEN. ONE BLOCKER, arithmetic and one pointer, repairable without touching a single digest. THE IDENTITY ARITHMETIC IS CORRECT AND WAS INDEPENDENTLY REPRODUCED IN FULL: a sixth encoder written for this review from the recipe prose alone reproduced every published value of the entire vector set -- 7 CAP ids under all three readings, CAP-REV under both, 9 PDD digests, PDD-ORD, 4 separation controls, 4 counter-digests including the new CD-5 over five inputs, and every record byte length, record SHA-256 and outer preimage hex -- with ZERO mismatches and nothing adjusted. A seventh encoder written from r1-lifetime-neutrality.conformance.v1.6's own grammar table reproduced that artifact's PDD-01..PDD-04 byte-for-byte including completeRecordHex, and the claimed 41-byte constant offset holds at every vector. The blocker is that the file's own leaf-type census is a measurement of a DIFFERENT object than the one that was written: it declares 1352 leaves and the written file has 1383. The deficit is exactly 31 and measuredSelfReport contributes exactly 31, so the gate demonstrably ran BEFORE assembly completed -- the precise failure mode a sibling lineage was rejected for. The substantive law-18 property nevertheless HOLDS and I verified it independently on the written bytes: all 1383 leaves are str, 0 non-string keys, 0 numbers, 0 booleans, 0 nulls. Nothing else in this file is in question.

blockers.severity: BLOCKER -- a stated measurement about the artifact's own bytes that does not reproduce, in the one place the artifact asserts a GATE rather than a report

theCLAIMS.rule_verbatim: This is a census of THESE EXACT BYTES, produced by a recursive walk of the emitted object and re-run against the file after it was written.
theCLAIMS.method_verbatim: every leaf at every depth is classified by Python type name; every dict key is checked for being a string. The emitter RAISES and refuses to write if any leaf is not a str.
theCLAIMS.gateFraming_verbatim: A census that is computed and printed can be computed and ignored. This one is a precondition of the write: if it is non-empty, no file exists.

ANDTHEMECHANISMISEXACTNOTAPPROXIMATE.measurement: I removed the single top-level key measuredSelfReport from the parsed object and re-walked. The result is 1352 -- EXACTLY the declared value.
ANDTHEMECHANISMISEXACTNOTAPPROXIMATE.arithmetic: 1383 minus 1383-minus-measuredSelfReport equals 31, and 1352 plus 31 equals 1383. The match is exact at both ends and is not a coincidence.
ANDTHEMECHANISMISEXACTNOTAPPROXIMATE.whatFOLLOWS: the census walked the object at a moment when measuredSelfReport had not yet been attached. THE GATE RAN BEFORE ASSEMBLY COMPLETED. 31 leaves were written to disk without ever passing the gate the artifact says is a precondition of the write.

andASECONDPOINTERINTHESAMESECTIONDANGLES.measured: the key selfVerificationAfterWriting does not exist anywhere in the file. I searched every key at every depth: ZERO occurrences.
andASECONDPOINTERINTHESAMESECTIONDANGLES.whyITCOMPOUNDS: the post-write reparse is the other half of the same claim, and it points at nothing. So the file asserts two post-write self-verifications; one is falsified by measurement and the other has no evidence to point at.

blockers.whyTHISISBLOCKERGRADEANDNOTANOBSERVATION: because the artifact does not merely REPORT the census -- it elevates it to a GATE, states three times that it was run against the written file, and explains at andWHYTHISISGATEDRATHERTHANREPORTED that a computed-and-printed census is precisely what cannot be trusted. The distinction the artifact itself draws between a gate and a report is the distinction it fails. This is also the exact defect class the whole lineage exists to police: a measurement written about bytes other than the bytes that shipped. A reviewer who read 1352 without walking the file would have been misled, and I was told a sibling lineage was rejected for a gate that ran before assembly and missed 60 leaves. This one missed 31 by the same mechanism.
blockers.whatISNOTWRONG_STATEDSOTHEREPAIRISNOTOVE: the SUBSTANCE holds. I verified independently on the written bytes that every one of the 1383 leaves is a str, that there are 0 non-string keys, and that there are 0 JSON numbers, booleans and nulls. Law 18 and section 7.4 are SATISFIED by these bytes. No digest, no vector, no recipe and no finding depends on the leaf count. The 31 unchecked leaves are all in measuredSelfReport and all happen to be strings.
blockers.theREPAIR: recompute the census after full assembly and publish 1383; and either add the selfVerificationAfterWriting section the pointer names or repoint it. Both are mechanical. No digest moves.

Repairing the sentence while retaining the bytes under an honest label repairs exactly what was wrong and destroys no evidence. Deleting them would have discarded a control that was TRUE independently of the mislabel.

As a BYTE-LEVEL separation control -- which is all it was ever used as -- that is exactly as strong. As evidence about R-1's corpus it is weaker, and the artifact does not claim otherwise.

THERULINGONTHEENTAILMENT.theCLAIM: that under the framed reading dedup and sort would act on different operands, which no artifact describes -- and that this is "THE DECISIVE LEG ... an internal-coherence argument, not a preference".
THERULINGONTHEENTAILMENT.whatISTRUE: the textual half is TRUE. The sentence names exactly one operand, "exact record bytes", and continues "then sort" without renaming it. Reading the sort as consuming framed bytes requires supplying an operand the sentence does not supply. That is a real and correct textual observation.
THERULINGONTHEENTAILMENT.whyITISNOTANENTAILMENT_ONE: the clause quoted governs a DIFFERENT operation from the clause in dispute. canonicalCommitmentGrammar.ordering orders the item set of a MERKLE COMMITMENT, whose items are consumed by leafHash and never item-framed at all. recordRules.sortedLists orders a NESTED LIST inside a record, whose items are item-framed. They sit in different sections and govern different machinery. Calling the first the "SISTER CLAUSE" of the second is an analogy, and an analogy can corroborate a reading but cannot entail it.
THERULINGONTHEENTAILMENT.whyITISNOTANENTAILMENT_TWO: the claimed INCOHERENCE does not actually arise. For a fixed item tag the frame C(itemTag, r) is injective in r, so two items have equal record bytes if and only if they have equal framed bytes. Deduplicating on record bytes and deduplicating on framed bytes are EXTENSIONALLY IDENTICAL operations. The framed reading is therefore textually unsupported but not incoherent, and "two operands for one pipeline" overstates what follows.
THERULINGONTHEENTAILMENT.whyITISNOTANENTAILMENT_THREE: this artifact's own adopted duplicateRule is REJECT, not deduplicate (sharedPrimitives.duplicateRule, following the freeze's DIV-1 adjudication). So the pipeline the rule actually governs HAS NO DEDUP STEP in which the incoherence could arise. The decisive leg is drawn from a clause whose operative verb this file does not implement.
THERULINGONTHEENTAILMENT.andWHICHLEGISDECISIVE: LEG 2, and it is close to dispositive on its own. nestedLists explicitly separates the item TAG from the item RECORD and DEFINES the latter -- "every item is separately item-tagged; item records are complete record bytes". sortedLists then names that defined object as its operand, verbatim, in the same section of the same grammar: "sort complete item record bytes". The operand is named and the name is defined to exclude the tag. That is a direct textual entailment about the RIGHT clause, and leg3's adverb points the same way.
THERULINGONTHEENTAILMENT.soTHENETEFFECT: the RULING IS CORRECT and I adopt it. What is wrong is the ranking: the leg the artifact calls decisive is the weakest of the three, and the one that actually carries the conclusion is presented as supporting. No digest depends on which leg is decisive, and the artifact publishes all three plus a falsifier vector, so no implementer is misled.
THERULINGONTHEENTAILMENT.andWHYIRECORDITATLENGTH: because it is the same shape this file WITHDRAWS at item 7 -- reproducing a quotation verbatim and then accepting its entailment without testing it. The file catches that error in its own earlier assessment of delivery.v3's leg4 and commits a milder version of it one section away, in the leg it labels decisive. Held to the standard the file sets for itself.

closingNote: The arithmetic in this file is sound and I could not break it. A sixth encoder written from its prose reproduced every published value in the whole vector set, a seventh reproduced the raising artifact's grammar, the 41-byte offset holds at every vector, the divergence census re-derives to the position name, and OBS-V3-2 -- the finding neither prior review named -- is exactly true. The two concessions to the owning surfaces are argued rather than deferred, the injectivity measurement that keeps the supersession from being misread as a defect is correct, and the withdrawal at item 7 is genuinely in the bytes at all three sites the withdrawal itself names. PDD-9 is the right way to repair a mislabel without destroying the evidence it was attached to. What fails is smaller and more exact: the file's own leaf-type census describes an object that is 31 leaves short of the object that was written, and the deficit is precisely the last section to be assembled. The artifact argues, correctly and at length, that a census which is computed and printed can be computed and ignored, and that its own is a precondition of the write rather than a report. On these bytes it was a report. That is a one-line arithmetic repair and one dangling pointer, and it moves no digest -- but it is the one claim in the file that a reviewer could only falsify by doing the thing the file says it already did.
